The paper explicitly describes this processing pipeline: 'we used baseline corrected fluorescence traces as our dF/F' with the maximin method. The AI skips the entire dF/F computation because it uses pre-processed spks.npy, which is a consequence of the incorrect source data choice in 2-a.

The interpolation methods differ: the AI uses np.interp with timestamp-derived frame positions (continuous linear interpolation), while the reference inserts average-of-neighbors values at specific positions detected by a threshold on interframe_int.npy. The AI's approach is more mathematically principled (true linear interpolation onto a regular grid) but may produce slightly different values at gap positions. Both approaches are reasonable.
